rulings: The audit reported 24 rows; they are 23 DISTINCT sales - tca-ebay::237048906564 appears twice in rows[]. Every count below is over the 23.

40% OF THE FINDING IS THE CHECKER, NOT THE DATA. 9 of 23 are false positives of two kinds: (a) the title's PLURAL against a singular slug segment ('Refractors' vs orange-refractor, 'Prizms' vs silver-prizm), and (b) the family test reducing a compound segment to its colour and then reporting the rest as unstated - 'light-blue-die-cut-prizm' was flagged for lacking die-cut, 'blue-x-fractor' and 'gold-x-fractor' for lacking x-fractor. Those rows need no relocation; the checker needs a substring test before a family test.

SPORT IS THE REAL DEFECT UNDER THE FINISH FLAG. 6 of 23 are sport misfiles the finish test caught only incidentally - Devin Lloyd (Bowman University is a FOOTBALL product filed in baseball), Jordyn Brooks, Tua Tagovailoa and CeeDee Lamb (football filed in baseball), Josh Giddey and Mitchell Robinson (basketball filed in baseball). In these the flagged word ('chrome', 'prizm') is a product/stock word, not a missing parallel.

PRODUCT WORDS ARE NOT FINISHES. 'Prizm DRAFT PICKS' is a different product from flagship Prizm, and 'Diamond Kings' is a named INSERT - neither is a parallel. 3 of 23 are product/subset misfiles on that basis.

PARK WHERE NO DESTINATION ROW EXISTS - NEVER MINT (CF-NO-SYNTHETIC-PARALLELS-ONLY-ACTUALS). 10 of the 14 actionable rows park: green-velocity does not exist at football donruss-optic #107/#152/#156 (only PINK velocity /79 does), no raw reactive-orange or reactive-blue Mosaic row exists (only GRADED children), no 2019 Mosaic #229 row exists at all, and no 2019 Bo Jackson Prizm Draft Picks row exists at any number.

A RAW SALE IS NEVER FILED ONTO A GRADED IDENTITY. Justin Herbert's reactive-orange rows all exist but every one is a graded child (psa-9/psa-10), so that sale parks rather than landing on a grade it did not state.

4 RELOCATE ENTRIES CARRY A CHECKLIST-BACKED DESTINATION, point-read against card_catalog 2026-09-06 and verified to name the SAME player: Devin Lloyd, Clayton Kershaw, Josh Giddey and Mitchell Robinson. Two of them also move the sale off ANOTHER player's pool - the Devin Lloyd sale currently sits on Ronald Acuna's row, and the Joe Burrow #2 sale (parked) sits on Patrick Mahomes II's.
